from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u053/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9f855a99.py')

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,)]
    # Background is the most frequent value; markers are the other value.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        cols = [c for rr,c in pts if rr == r]
        for a,b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(len(grid[0])):
        rows = [r for r,cc in pts if cc == c]
        for a,b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
